title: AOCL Canonical Execution Semantics document (AOCL-CR-010)
description: The canonical ExecutionInstance established by AOCL-CR-010 — the architectural transition between the Modeling stage and the engines: a governed, versioned binding of one BehavioralSpecification (CR-006), one SimulationScenario (CR-009) and the referenced control/evidence models (CR-007/008) into a runnable interpretation with declared policies for activation (graph-faithful, EXE-008/010), condition and transition evaluation order (EXE-012..018), event ordering resolution honoring scenario declarations (EXE-019..021), time basis (EXE-022), action dispatch preserving the CR-007 evidential chain (EXE-024..026), approval-gate suspension (EXE-027/028), exception escalation (EXE-029..031), safe-state authority and verification (EXE-032/033), seeded determinism (EXE-034/035), and RUNTIME information-visibility enforcement (EXE-036/037 — the simulated Controller never receives the scenario's hidden ground truth; P30/P31). Trace obligations are declared here; the trace format itself is CR-013's (EXE-038). Structural rules are expressed here and enforced natively by src/aocl/execution.py, which adds policy coherence checks and mode-specific engine readiness (logical vs state-based, distinct profiles). No engine implementation is defined or implied (AD-010-12).

basis.description: EXE-022 — a mode without a declared time basis is non-conformant.

entryPolicy.description: EXE-010: DeclaredEntry required — execution begins at the specification's declared entry elements.

graphWalkOnly.description: EXE-008: activation follows the behavioral graph; no implied sequencing. Must be true.

freshnessPolicy.description: EXE-014: BlockOnStale required — stale evidence blocks dependent evaluation, never silently proceeds.

items.description: EXE-013: delegated evaluations name the responsible reference and result contract.

authorityCheck.description: EXE-016: AlwaysDeclared required — authority checked against the CR-007 AuthorityDefinition at dispatch, never inferred.

effectApplication.description: EXE-017: DeclaredDeltas required — effects applied as declared with postcondition kinds preserved.

orderingResolution.description: EXE-019: PerScenarioDeclaration required — ordering honors the scenario's per-event declarations (SCN-033).

tieBreak.description: EXE-020: DeclaredDeterministic required — simultaneous events never resolve accidentally (P29).

dependenciesBlock.description: EXE-021: must be true — dependents blocked until dependencies resolve.

cyclePolicy.description: EXE-023: PerVelocityDeclaration required — cycle execution follows the loop's velocity.

chain.description: EXE-024: the full CR-007 chain, in order — acknowledgement never advances state as if execution occurred (AD-007-09).

distinctRecords.description: EXE-024: must be true — the chain stages are distinct runtime records (P32).

budgetsDeclared.description: Required true when permitted — retries only within declared budgets (EXE-026); no implicit retry.

approvalGate.description: EXE-027: Suspend required — approval elements suspend the path into WaitingApproval.

timeoutPolicy.description: EXE-028: follows the CR-006 participation declaration.

handlerResolution.description: EXE-029: DeclaredPaths required — exceptions resolve through the specification's HandlesException paths.

unhandledPolicy.description: EXE-030: Escalate required — unhandled exceptions follow the CR-007 dispositions, never silent absorption.

criticalUnresolvedBlock.description: EXE-031: must be true — critical unresolved exceptions (BSS-026) block execution readiness.

authorityRequired.description: EXE-032: must be true — safe-state entry uses the pre-authorized protective mechanism.

verificationRequired.description: EXE-033: must be true — a safe state is never treated as established without its declared verification (CTM-032).

seedPolicy.description: EXE-034: Declared required — all stochastic behavior flows through declared seeded sources (P33).

sameInputsSameTrace.description: EXE-035: must be true — same declared inputs yield the same trace within an engine version (P34).

channelPolicy.description: EXE-037: SeparatedChannels required — actual, observed and estimated remain separate runtime channels (P31).

controllerVisiblePolicy.description: EXE-036/P30: PerScenarioDeclaration required — the simulated Controller receives exactly what the scenario declares visible (SCN-027), never the ground truth. Full is forbidden.

enforcement.description: Runtime required — the visibility declaration is enforced by the interpreter itself, not left to scenario authoring discipline.

records.description: EXE-038: all obligatory record classes — the format, recording and replay are CR-013's.

temporalRefs.description: EXE-038: must be true — every record carries its temporal reference.

originClass.description: EXE-039/AD-008-11: simulation modes produce SimulationEvidence — OperationalTime at definition level is invalid.

runIdentity.description: EXE-039: Declared required — runtime evidence carries run identity (VER-039).

distinctFromModelLifecycle.description: EXE-006: must be true — distinct from model/spec/scenario lifecycles and run status.

temporalRecording.description: EXE-007: lifecycle transitions recorded with temporal references.

carriedPolicies.description: Canvas/engine policies carried as declared semantics (§19) — never silently promoted to Approved.
